//: ClaudeAgentsBar configuration. Copy this file to:
//3: or any path pointed to by $CLAUDE_AGENTS_BAR_CONFIG
//meta: All fields are optional. Missing or invalid values fall back to defaults.
//meta1: Keys starting with '//' are ignored — use them as comments.
// window_minutes: How far back the dropdown lists sessions. Anything older is hidden. Default: 180 (3h).
// fresh_minutes: How long an idle session stays 🟢 FRESH after Stop without any click. After this it auto-promotes to 🔵 ACKNOWLEDGED. A click before the timer expires promotes it immediately. Default: 60.
// ack_minutes: How long an idle session stays 🔵 ACKNOWLEDGED before fading to ⚪ STALE. Each new click while ACKNOWLEDGED restarts this timer. Default: 60.
// watchdog_seconds: A 'working' session whose last event is older than this is treated as 'idle' — covers sessions that crashed mid-tool and never emitted Stop. Default: 90.
// title_max: Max length of a session title on a row, with an ellipsis appended on overflow. Default: 60.
// menubar_icon: Icon drawn before the counters. Prefixes:
// menubar_icon.1: • plain glyph    — '🤖', '✨', '🪄', '🧠' (Apple Color Emoji, won't match SF Pro baselines)
// menubar_icon.3: • 'template:<path>' — monochrome PNG, macOS auto-tints to match the menu bar (recommended)
// menubar_icon.5: Paths may be absolute or relative to the plugin directory.
// menubar_icon.6: Template/image sources are auto-resized to fit the menu bar height; the resized copy is cached under $XDG_CACHE_HOME/claude-agents-bar/.
// menubar_icon.7: Default points at Claude.app's tray icon — shows the Claude mark when Claude.app is installed.
// menubar_icon_fallback: Glyph used when 'menubar_icon' points at a missing file (e.g. Claude.app not installed). Default: '🤖'.
// editor_url_scheme: URL scheme prefix used to build the per-row deeplink that opens a session in your editor.
// editor_url_scheme.2: Default: 'vscode://' — works for stock Visual Studio Code.
// editor_url_scheme.3: VSCodium: set to 'vscodium://'. Cursor: set to 'cursor://'. macOS does not register the 'vscode://' scheme for these forks, so clicks on rows do nothing until this is changed.
// editor_url_scheme.4: Other Code-OSS forks may register their own scheme. Must include the trailing '://'.
// editor_url_scheme.5: The editor must also have the 'anthropic.claude-code' extension installed for the deeplink to land on a session.
// language: UI language for menu labels, dialogs, and 'X ago' strings.
// language.1: Supported codes: 'en', 'ru', 'zh', 'zh-TW', 'fr', 'de', 'it', 'vi'. Region tag is optional — 'zh-TW' picks Taiwan locale, others fall back to the primary subtag (e.g. 'zh') then 'en'.
// language.2: Default '' (or 'auto') detects from macOS AppleLocale, falling back to $LANG.
// language.3: Plugin metadata (About box) is localized by SwiftBar itself via <xbar.title.<lang>> headers in the plugin file.
// compact: Compact menu-bar format. Hides the Claude icon and replaces wide emoji circles (🟡🟢🔵) with narrow ANSI-coloured '●' bullets: '●2 ●1 ●3' instead of '[icon] 🟡2 🟢1 🔵3'. Saves ~30 px — useful on MacBook with notch and no external display. Default: false.
// context_window_tokens: Denominator for the per-session '{N}% — {used}k/{total}k' submenu indicator. Default 1000000 — matches Claude Opus 4.7 / Opus 4.6 / Sonnet 4.6, which is Anthropic's API default since 2026-04-23 and what Claude Code uses out of the box. Override down to 200000 when running Haiku 4.5 or Sonnet 4.5. Must be > 0; invalid values fall back to the default with a warning to SwiftBar's log.
// context_warning_threshold: Percent of context-window usage above which the row gets an inline '⚠ {pct}%' marker between the title and the age label. Default 80 (matches the yellow zone in Claude Code's own CLI). The marker turns red once usage crosses 90 %. Set to 100 to disable the warning while keeping the submenu gauge. Valid range: 1..100; out-of-range or non-int values fall back to 80.
// notify_on_stop: Show a macOS notification (and play a chime + spoken phrase) when a session finishes. Requires terminal-notifier (brew install terminal-notifier). Default: true.
// notify_threshold_sec: Skip notifications for sessions whose last user turn was less than this many seconds ago — avoids noise from quick one-liner exchanges. Default: 30.
// notify_phrases: Phrases spoken aloud via 'say' and shown in the notification banner. One is chosen at random on each Stop. Default is a short built-in list.
// notify_on_wait: Play a chime, speak a phrase, and show a macOS notification banner when Claude is blocked on a tool-approval dialog (PermissionRequest event). Requires terminal-notifier. Default: true.
// notify_wait_phrases: Phrases spoken aloud via 'say' and shown in the notification banner when Claude is waiting for permission. One is chosen at random on each PermissionRequest. Default is a short built-in list.
// notify_sound_stop.4: • null  — suppress the chime; banner and voice still fire
// notify_sound_stop.5: A missing file or unknown bare name logs a warning to SwiftBar's log and falls back to no chime for that event. Default: 'Hero'.
// notify_sound_wait: Chime played on PermissionRequest — same value shapes as notify_sound_stop. Default: 'Funk' (shorter, softer than Hero).
// notify_voice: say(1) voice for the spoken phrase. Accepts:
// notify_voice.4: Run 'say -v ?' in Terminal to list installed voices. Shared by both Stop and PermissionRequest events. Default: null.
// quiet_hours: Scheduled silence window (24h local, 'HH:MM-HH:MM'). start>end wraps midnight. Default '23:00-08:00' — set to null to disable.
// quiet_hours_silences: Which channels are silenced while quiet hours are active. Subset of ['sound','voice','banner']. Default = ['sound','voice'] — audio is muted but the banner still appears. Add 'banner' to go fully silent.
// keep_awake: First-launch keep-awake mode. Once you click a mode in Tools → Keep awake, the sidecar takes precedence and this knob is only consulted on the next clean install. Values: 'off' (default), 'auto' (caffeinate while any session is working), 'always'. Limitations: closed lid + no external display still sleeps; this only inhibits idle/display sleep.
// multi_workspace_mode: When true (default), clicking a session (dropdown row or notification banner) first raises the editor window that owns the session's working directory, then fires the deeplink — so it lands in the right window even with several windows / a multi-root workspace open. It does this by opening a file inside the cwd (the session's last touched file, else README) so the editor focuses the owning window, costing one extra tab. Set to false if you only ever run one editor window: clicks then fire the deeplink directly (instant, no extra tab, but they land in whatever window is frontmost).
// editor_focus_settle_sec: Only used when multi_workspace_mode is true. Seconds to wait after raising the window before firing the deeplink, so the anchor tab finishes rendering and the resumed chat lands on top of it instead of under it. Default 0.1. Lower trims latency but risks landing on the file under load; 0 skips the wait. Range 0..5.
